record.field: get_messages

Get the chatter messages and activity log for a specific record. Returns the message history including comments, notes, status changes, and field tracking (who changed what and when). Requires the 'mail' module to be installed. Use this to understand the history of a record — e.g. who approved a purchase order, when was an invoice sent, what notes were left on a contact.
read
post_message

Post a message on a record's chatter (the discussion thread). This is used to leave comments, notes, or send notifications on any record that has the mail.thread mixin (most business records like sale.order, account.move, project.task, etc.). Use type 'comment' for messages visible to followers, or 'note' for internal notes only visible to internal users.
write
update_product_price

Update the sales price and/or cost price of a product. Use this to change what a product sells for (lst_price) or its internal cost (standard_price). Requires the product template ID (not variant ID). Returns the updated values as confirmation.
write
rename_product

Rename a product and optionally update its internal reference code and sales description. Requires the product template ID. At least one of name, internal_reference, or description must be provided. Returns the updated product fields as confirmation.
write
update_customer

Update a customer or contact's details in Odoo. Can update name, email, phone, street address, city, zip/postal code, and country. Requires the partner ID. At least one field to update must be provided. Country is resolved by name (e.g. 'United States'). Returns updated fields as confirmation.
write
update_stock_quantity

Set the on-hand stock quantity for a product at a specific location using an inventory adjustment. Requires a product.product ID (variant, not template). Location defaults to the main stock location (WH/Stock) if not provided. Returns the new quantity after applying the adjustment.
write
create_product
Create a new product in Odoo. Requires a product name. Optionally set sales price, cost price, internal reference (SKU), and sales description. Returns the new product's ID and details.
write
create_customer

Create a new customer in Odoo. Requires a customer name. Optionally set email, phone, street address, city, zip/postal code, and country. The record is automatically flagged as a customer. Country is resolved by name (e.g. 'United States'). Returns the new customer's ID and details.
write
